name: mnemonic_shard_burst_leap
label: Mnemonic Shardburst Leap
godotFeature: Godot Physics 3D (CharacterBody3D), GDScript for state management and dynamic property alteration, custom procedural generation system for environmental changes
poeticVision: The desperate lunge of a mind tearing itself apart to escape. Players will feel the visceral cost of survival as they physically sacrifice a piece of who they are, momentarily becoming a blur of anguish and speed, knowing that each escape pushes them further into the void of self. It's a feeling of empowering self-destruction, a tragic sprint, where the player actively chooses which part of their fading self to burn away for a fleeting chance at survival.
usage: Attach this script to your player's CharacterBody3D node. The `activate_shardburst_leap` function should be called from your player input handler, passing the `memory_id` of the memory shard the player chooses to sacrifice. For example, `if Input.is_action_just_pressed("leap_ability"): activate_shardburst_leap("childhood_home")`. The `MemoryManager` is provided as an inner class for standalone demonstration; in a full project, it should be implemented as a separate GDScript file and registered as an AutoLoad (singleton) in Project Settings -> AutoLoad. The `memory_lost` signal emitted by the `MemoryManager` can be connected to your procedural generation system or narrative manager to dynamically alter game elements based on the lost memory.

parameters.name: leap_strength
parameters.description: The magnitude of the velocity boost applied during the leap.

parameters.name: leap_duration
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for which the leap's velocity boost is active.

parameters.name: cooldown_time
parameters.description: The time in seconds before the Mnemonic Shardburst Leap can be activated again after use.

parameters.name: memory_manager_path
parameters.description: The NodePath to the MemoryManager singleton. This manager handles the storage and consumption of memory shards.

dependencies: CharacterBody3D (the node this script is attached to)
MemoryManager (an AutoLoad singleton, or the provided inner class for demonstration)
verdict: A desperate surge of self-destruction, where every fleeting escape carves a deeper void into the soul Lyra fights to reclaim.
impact: This mechanic will force players into agonizing choices, making every escape a moment of profound loss. It transforms a simple movement ability into a narrative device, deepening the player's connection to Lyra's struggle against forgetting. The player will constantly weigh immediate survival against the slow erosion of identity, creating a unique blend of adrenaline and melancholic reflection.
